FALAK SOLO 

We are a passionate team of developers and Management Information Systems students based in Cairo. We specialize in building full-stack web platforms and data management systems.

Our focus for the hackathon is to work collaboratively to design and build a complete, end-to-end platform using NASA open-source data (Website + Admin Dashboard).

We are fully structured with all necessary technical roles and ready to collaborate effectively.

First time at NASA Space Apps Challenge!
summary: AstroKids: Outpost Command is an interactive, zero-lag, browser-based 2D educational space survival simulation designed for children aged 7–12. Space education for young learners often stays either too abstract or overly technical, leaving kids without hands-on experience in how astronauts actually make life-critical engineering decisions. Our solution puts players in command of a Lunar (Artemis Base) or Martian (Jezero Crater) outpost for 10 Sols (days), governed by a realistic "2-out-of-3" reactor power rule across Radiation Shielding, a CSA Hydroponic Farm, and Science & Earth Comms. Powered by live and verified open data from NASA (DONKI, OSDR, RadLab, Mars Trek, APOD, Mars Rover Photos, NeoWs) and the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), the game teaches real spaceflight trade-offs, solar storm preparedness, and signal delays through non-punitive feedback, interactive science quizzes, read-aloud accessibility, and a personalized printable Commander Certificate.
details:
## Overview & How It Works

**AstroKids: Outpost Command** is a lightweight, zero-download 2D cutaway simulation built for learners aged 7–12. Players enter their Commander Name, choose between a **Lunar Outpost (Artemis Base)** with a 1.3s Earth signal time or a **Martian Base (Jezero Crater)** with realistic communication delays, and manage the outpost across **10 Sols (space days)**.

Every Sol introduces real-data environmental events, solar flare alerts, and interactive multiple-choice science challenges. Players manage three vital outpost systems using a strict **"2-out-of-3" Power Rule**:

1. **Radiation Shielding (🛡️):** Protects crew DNA from solar flares and cosmic radiation (`mSv/day`).

2. **CSA Hydroponic Greenhouse (🌿):** Produces oxygen and food while teaching closed-loop life support.

3. **Science Lab & Earth Comms (🔬):** Transmits collected Martian/Lunar telemetry back to Earth across realistic signal-delay windows.

Because the base reactor can only power **two systems simultaneously**, turning a third switch ON automatically powers down the oldest active system—teaching kids that in real spaceflight engineering, **no choice is free**.

## Educational Benefits & Impact

- **Non-Punitive Learning Loop:** If Oxygen or Radiation Safety drops critically low, an *Emergency Pod Save* explains the exact cause-and-effect in kid-friendly language rather than a harsh "Game Over," encouraging strategic iteration alongside a **Reset Sol** option.

- **Accessibility for Young Readers:** Includes a built-in **Read-Aloud** feature (Web Speech API), contextual science glossary tooltips (*Sol, Solar Flare, Hydroponics, Absorbed Dose*), and bilingual support (English & Arabic).

- **Tangible Achievement:** Surviving 10 Sols unlocks collectible NASA/CSA science cards and generates a personalized, printable **Certificate of Excellence** comparing the player's decisions to real NASA mission-control protocols.

## Creativity & Human-Centered Considerations

Our team (**falak solo**) balanced scientific authenticity with playful 2D visual storytelling. Instead of overwhelming children with raw telemetry tables, we translated NASA dosimetry and space weather metrics into visual animations—an astronaut reacting inside a cutaway base, dynamic dust/radiation bars, and concise "Onboard Computer Cause & Effect" explanations.

## Tools, Languages & Architecture

- **Frontend & Animations:** React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, and custom 2D SVG/CSS animations for instant, lag-free performance on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.

- **Data Integration:** Live NASA Open APIs (`DONKI`, `APOD`, `Mars Rover Photos`, `NeoWs`) paired with a verified offline dataset fallback (`OSDR`, `RadLab`, `Mars Trek`, `CSA`) so gameplay never breaks due to network issues.

- **Audio & Export:** Synthesized sound effects via Web Audio API, narration via Web Speech API (`speechSynthesis`), and client-side HTML5 Canvas/Print generation for the Commander Certificate.

- **Source Code Repository:** https://github.com/mxzav/AstroKids
